text:
taylor: Heads up — deploy-bot flagged a canary error-rate spike on /v1/generate at 09:12 PT. Holding the rollout. p95 +20%, error-rate 6.2% (>3% threshold). Need a decision on rollback vs partial pin.

deploy-bot: AUTOMATION: Canary monitoring triggered. Canary error-rate: 6.2% (threshold 3%). Failed checks: 5-min p95 latency and 1-min error-rate. Suggested action: pause rollout and consider manual revert to v2.9.1. Details: https://telemetry/redwood/canary/1764445555

maria: Agree pause. Is this isolated to hosted-prod-usw? I see the bulk of errors coming from embeddings route — could we pin embeddings to previous model instead of a full rollback?

raj: Any customer-facing errors reported? Support dashboard shows a few timeouts but not widespread 500s yet. Need to weigh exposure vs rollback cost.

sam: Runbook options: (1) Pause rollout (done), (2) Shift 20% back to previous version for canary (quick test), (3) If no improvement in 10m -> full rollback. Who can kick the targeted traffic-split?

elena: If we do rollback I'll update release notes and notify CS/legal. Draft blurb ready to go once we know path.

taylor: Assigning execs: @maria please run the traffic-split. @raj please assess customer impact and whether to escalate. @sam stand by for rollback steps.

maria: On it. Running split now: `redwood deploy traffic set --service api --from 2.10.0 --to 2.9.1 --percent 20 --region usw`

deploy-bot: ACTION: Traffic split command accepted. 20% to v2.9.1 in us-west. Telemetry will re-evaluate in 5m.

taylor: Waiting for metrics. If errors drop below 3% at 20% -> gradual ramp down; if not -> full revert.

maria: Metrics after 6m: error-rate @canary down to 3.5%, p95 still +12%. Not under threshold. I recommend escalating to full rollback.

raj: +1 to rollback. CS has opened a ticket and notified the five customers on rotation. No major escalations yet but noise is increasing.

sam: Agreed. Preparing to execute manual rollback. Steps: `redwood deploy revert --service api --to 2.9.1 --regions all` — will coordinate staged drain with eng-oncall. ETA ~8m.

deploy-bot: AUTOMATION: Initiating revert lock. Preventing new canary promotions during rollback window.

maria: Executing revert now. `redwood deploy revert --service api --to 2.9.1 --regions all --staged`

taylor: Please post status updates as you go. I will update release notes when you confirm completion.

deploy-bot: STATUS: Revert job started (job id jb_89234).

maria: Revert 1/3: drained canaries in us-west -> OK. 2/3: deployed 2.9.1 to us-west -> OK. 3/3: rolling verify now.

deploy-bot: METRICS: Post-rollback (us-west) 3m sample: error-rate 0.9%, p95 latency +3% — within SLO.

elena: Updated release notes and posted a short customer-facing blurb. Sent to CS for outbound. Draft link: https://docs.internal/release/1764445555/blurb

raj: CS acked the message. Monitoring will continue for 30m; no escalations at this time.

taylor: :thumbsup: Great work. We'll run a postmortem tomorrow to identify root cause and whether finer-grained gating (model variant pin) can avoid full rollbacks.

maria: Will attach diagnostics, logs, and the traffic-split timeline to the PM ticket.

deploy-bot: COMPLETE: Revert finished (job id jb_89234). Rollback window closed.

taylor: Closing thread. Thanks everyone — special shoutout to @maria and @sam for quick execution. We'll follow up with postmortem actions.
